findings.finding: The CFO pre-guided Q3 as seasonally weaker q/q on every line: EBITDA slightly below Q2's 50.6m PLN, volumes down on maintenance stoppages at three mills. A print in that range lands inside what the company told the market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026: EBITDA beat the PAP consensus by 46% and the stock fell 11.7% on 31 Aug (that day's release also carried the weaker Q3 guide). Q3 2025: net loss 24.7m vs a 10.6m consensus, on the 12 Nov 2025 print.

Natomiast oczekiwałbym jednak odrobinę słabszej niż w drugim kwartale tego roku [we expect a downward correction in Q3 results at every level - sales, operating profit and net result - though it will certainly be much better than last year ... I would expect it to be slightly weaker than in Q2]
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The company said it out loud and the stock has fallen 35% over 60 days. It is filed to show the print is guided and is sized at 0. If the market had not absorbed it, the stock would not have dropped 11.7% on the day the guide came out.

findings.finding: Before the print, management described a turning market: rising distributor orders and steel prices, first long-product shipments to Ukraine, demand from infrastructure, energy and defence (supplier of 155mm shell steel). The CEO and main shareholder declared full support for the raise. With a bookbuild to come, the Q3 release has every incentive to carry a constructive Q4 outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 31 Aug the CFO said Q4 would not repeat the 2025 deterioration and the stock still fell 11.7% that day. On 18 May 2026 positive SAFE news lifted it more than 13% (Parkiet). Outlook statements have moved this name both ways.
findings.original_quote: Cognor obserwuje poprawę sytuacji rynkowej, w tym wzrost zamówień od dystrybutorów i cen stali. [Cognor sees an improving market, including rising orders from distributors and higher steel prices.]
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: it was published on 10 Nov and the stock still fell 7% on 12 Nov, so the market chose to read the dilution over the outlook. The unpriced part is any hard Q4 number (volumes, prices, order book) the release might add. If that were already in the price, the stock would not be trading at its 60-day low on above-normal volume.

findings.finding: Three days before the Q3 print, Cognor proposed a non-pre-emptive placement of up to 27.84m shares (~12% of capital, about 115-120m PLN at market). Its stated purposes include strengthening equity, restructuring liabilities and funding working capital; H1 was funded mainly by an overdraft above 124m PLN. This points to a tight Q3 balance sheet (net debt, working capital) in the release, and a discounted bookbuild after the 7 Dec EGM is an overhang inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: November 2025 placement: 60m new shares priced at 5.00 PLN and the stock fell about 21% to 5.28 PLN on 21 Nov 2025 (Bankier via BiznesRadar). This time the announcement cost -7% on 12 Nov 2026.
findings.original_quote: uelastycznienie i wzmocnienie kapitałów własnych na realizację i poprawę struktury zobowiązań finansowych, a także możliwość przeznaczenia ich na zwiększenie skali aktywności handlowej i rozwój sprzedaży [making equity more flexible and stronger, to improve the structure of financial liabilities, and to fund a larger scale of trading activity and sales growth]; Na bieżąco finansował się jednak przede wszystkim dzięki kredytowi w rachunku bieżącym przekraczającemu 124 mln zł [day to day it financed itself mainly through an overdraft above 124m PLN]
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced (-7% on 12 Nov, record volume). What is not yet seen is the 30 Sep net debt and working capital, which the release will show for the first time. Financing was treated as a question: the money buys working capital for a volume ramp, and the Ukraine shipments, distributor orders and price rises corroborate that ramp. That is why the size is small and not a distress-sized negative.
findings.independence: https://www.parkiet.com/surowce-i-paliwa/art45473501-cognor-szykuje-emisje-akcji-chce-wykorzystac-ozywienie-na-rynku-stali. This rests on the same RB-12 filing, so it is not independent.

baseline_tension: The findings come out about neutral: a guided quarter, a constructive outlook and a financing overhang that offset each other. The 20-day run-up of -20% makes the lean and the free control mildly positive (mean reversion). The slight negative financing finding agrees with the momentum and cuts against the lean; p_up 49 reflects that the evidence does not beat the lean either way.
language_note: The issuer's own Polish investor calendar confirmed the 13.11.2026 date and its current-report list showed there is no szacunkowe-wyniki pre-release. No English source carried either.

The CFO's Q3 verbal guide (weaker q/q on every line, EBITDA slightly below Q2, stoppages at three mills) came only from Polish wire copy (Strefa Inwestorów/PAP). English coverage (SteelOrbis, GMK) carried H1 figures only.
